tower.uuid: server-generated stable UUID for this tower lifetime

identity.controllerBinding: Exactly zero or one tower identity; many controllers may bind the same tower
identity.replacement: Rebuild at identical coordinates receives a new UUID; explicit rebind required
identity.deviceIdentityImplementation: Proposed; not claimed to exist in current devices

ownership.configuration: tower base, never a controller-local copy
ownership.clientSnapshot: read-only cache with revision and freshness; never authoritative

range.status: numeric range and metric TBD; server-owned policy, not client-provided

loading.unloadedTarget: reject as unavailable; do not search-load or trust cached completeness

bind.result: validated binding or explicit rejection; no implicit coordinate-only adoption

update.conflict: reject without overwriting; return fresh revision/snapshot only if still authorized
update.success: increment revision exactly once only after effective apply; acknowledge effective values
update.failure: no revision bump or partial config; no success indication; unwind newly acquired future tickets

unbind.permission: server validates actor and controller access

chunkLoading.dimension: bound tower dimension; cross-dimension selection rejected
chunkLoading.enable: validate complete selection and atomically reserve future ticket budget before success
chunkLoading.limitFailure: reject whole request; show fault/reason, never a success light
chunkLoading.towerRemovedOrInvalid: disable and release future tickets; controller removal alone is not tower removal
chunkLoading.restart: revalidate owner, tower identity/completeness and budget before any future ticket recreation

transferRate.zeroBurstAndDirectionSemantics: TBD; no enforcement in this preview

entry.functions: subset of server type capability allowlist

validation: identity must match loaded server device
belongs to bound tower management set
same dimension and within effective managed range
each requested function allowed for that type

deviceTypeCapabilityProposal.policy: Only these reviewed per-type candidates may become server capabilities; unknown type/function denied. All gates below are proposals, not existing tower controls.

gauge.observed: frequency/address, stock cache information, last order display

monitor.observed: local/peer timing, backlog, round-trip and link status display

requester.observed: handheld item opens requester menu, not a placed block
requester.mappingStatus: TBD item identity/holder/current-position validation; do not fabricate blockPos

responses.lamp: unbound / bound / out_of_range / fault are illustrative binding states; rejected apply never lights success

openDecisions: chunk limits and ticket lifetime policy
